candidates.description: This vector represents common phonemes and name components from Cantonese and Mandarin Chinese romanization.
This feature vector activates on verb stems or morphemes that frequently occur before inflectional suffixes in Latinate English vocabulary.
This feature vector activates on terms related to historical eras, empires, and socio-political systems.
This feature vector represents concepts related to warfare, government, and political authority across multiple languages.
This vector represents geographic regions, nationalities, and languages, with a strong emphasis on Italy and Southern Europe.
This feature activates on words and word fragments starting with the letters "ass" (case-insensitive) as well as phonetically or orthographically similar prefixes.
This feature activates on terms related to government administration, political systems, and historical periods or events.
This vector represents common word endings or suffixes containing the letter 'v' preceded by various vowels.
This feature vector represents nationalities, countries, and regional demonyms.
This vector represents historical political figures, leaders, and associated icons.
